title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode2 An Unfamiliar Live House

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
This place looks so big from over here!

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: I heard one of the bands is playing here for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Really...?
What kind of stuff do you think they play?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We really do seem to be dealing with a different kind of crowd here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Normally, the crowd's ready to have fun and eagerly anticipating the curtains going up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But everybody here seems much calmer. Some even appear a bit hostile.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm getting kind of nervous...
Do you think they'll like our performance?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Hona!
Our set list for this show's loaded with fun energy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why we're gonna put smiles on all their faces!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There is such thing as being too optimistic, but I like what you said.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is our first time playing here, so there is a chance that we won't be able to get a good groove going. Regardless, we still need to play as well as we can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, everyone! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll be playing at this live house for the first time today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Many of you have probably never heard of us, but we'd like to spread some positive energy with our music!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Oh wow...!
Hona's drumming and Shiho's playing her bass with more power than usual...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I need to do the same!
I have to turn this excitement into sound...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Yeah, there we go!
That should get everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(What's wrong?
We're playing so well... Ichi's doing an awesome job on the guitar too...)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'm not really feeling it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're not getting into it at all...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Until now, at least some people in the crowd would listen really closely...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(No, this is just our first song!
Our next one's gonna be...!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Their second one's kinda the same...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: I'm gonna go grab a drink.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll be finishing things off by playing a brand-new song that we wrote just for this day...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No, this is gonna do it... It has to! I mean, I wrote this song just for this show! I wrote it because I was super excited about playing for everyone here...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We'll be fine. I'm sure of it...
I'm really proud of this song and we practiced really hard!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, we've gotta give it everything we've got!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll raise my hand and everyone in the crowd will join me...)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yeah, I'm just not feeling it.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Another new band.
Wanna step out and take a break...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But... This song... I wrote it just for today... I was sure that everyone would really enjoy it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The audience didn't respond very well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I thought that was one of our best performances yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, a different live house means a different crowd with different needs, so there's no need to feel bad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This might just be a case where some people just aren't interested in hearing a new song by a band they've never heard of before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, even if it's not their cup of tea, you'd think they'd be willing to listen if we played a good song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: None of our songs seemed to reach anyone today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Our third one, in particular...
No one really seemed to like our new song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think was so bad about it...? I was so sure that it'd do great...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So much cheering...
And they were so quiet when we played.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They've gotta be around the same age as us, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes...
That's “anemone”. The ones who've already been scouted out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's who you were talking about...?

Thank you all for coming out today.
Next, we'll play you our fan favorite.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(My chest... It feels so tight...
It's like my heart's being squeezed really hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(These lyrics... And this melody...
It all sounds so sad, and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
It's quiet but so compelling...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Saku's songs just have this way of getting to me.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They always seem to find a way into my heart...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wait, they were the ones who seemed really bored during our performance...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But now, they're listening intently... Some are even crying...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can kinda see why too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Why is that...?
This song feels so cold, but there's this warmth to it. Just listening to it is making me feel really relaxed.)

Thank you for listening.
We'll see you again.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: I can't wait until your next show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were so quiet while we played, and now, they're like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Saku...
So that's the name of the vocalist who wrote these songs.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (How are they able to write songs like this? How is it that these songs are able to have such a huge effect on everyone...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I wanna learn how to do that.
I wanna write music that can move people's hearts...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me, Saku...!
Do you have a moment to talk?!
